title: The OGB, Original Grinder Buddy (TRWW)
description:
The OGB, Original Grinder Buddy (RWW)
The Original Grinder Buddy is manufactured by Rogue Wax Works and has been designed to work well with dynavap device. This grinder buddy can live in your grinder and can be used to pack bowls as well as tamp your herb down prior to use.
While this OGB Grinder Buddy has been designed to work with dynavap. It of course can be used to work with just about any vaporizer.
Included
1 x Rogue Wax Works Grinder Buddy (Dynavap Edition)
